Players Committee card image of [[F-11D Blaster Rifle (Remastered)|F-11D Blaster Rifle (Errata 3)]] (errata PC-E3), game text: “Deploy on your First Order warrior. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 if fired by a stormtrooper. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/f11dblasterrifle.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 e8445f0] (1 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
